evidence_policy: author-reported unless independent_reproduction=true; do not rank across different protocols

entries.title: SEAR: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agentic Robots
entries.mechanism: Controls retained experience, rerolls, familiar tasks, privileged state, budget, and luck across code-as-policy, agent-as-policy, and auto-research modes.
entries.evidence: Authors evaluate seven frontier LMs on 330 simulated and five physical tasks and report more than four years of aggregate agent runtime.
entries.limits: Budget equivalence and release completeness require audit; no independent reproduction.

entries.title: Towards Agentic Robots: A Systematic Survey and Taxonomy
entries.mechanism: Organizes agentic robotics into 17 categories across Model, Data, Environment, and Harness.
entries.limits: Not empirical evidence for any robot method.

entries.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
entries.mechanism: Repairs skills and harness first, retries persistent failures from saved states for attribution, and fine-tunes only unreliable substeps with self-collected data.
entries.evidence: Authors report unseen composite success 4.6 to 13.8 percent on RoboCasa365, with 28 percent of GPU time and 22 percent of demonstrations versus fine-tuning every substep.
entries.limits: Simulation and saved-state counterfactuals; no real-robot evidence or independent reproduction.

entries.title: EmbodiedEvo
entries.mechanism: Distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons and freezes them for independent agents in unseen scenes.
entries.evidence: Authors report RoboDojo-Sim score 44.48, success 37.82 percent, cross-model gains of 8.86 and 5.50 points, and 53 percent lower execution cost versus raw history.
entries.limits: Simulation; contact-rich tasks remain difficult; no independent reproduction.

entries.title: ChunkAct
entries.mechanism: Compiles experience into autonomous primitive chunks that return to the LLM planner only on failure.
entries.evidence: Authors report +5.0 points on LIBERO-Pro, 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.
entries.limits: Protocol-specific author comparison; novel disruptions and chunk-boundary attribution need testing.

entries.title: VeriVLA: Adaptive Test-Time Verification for Flow-Based VLAs with Latent World Models
entries.mechanism: Two-sample temporal and cross-sample variance trigger invokes a JEPA latent world model to rank action chunks by predicted task progress.
entries.evidence: Authors report real-task completion 50.8 to 65.5 percent with 326 ms added per triggered decision; gains are also reported on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO.
entries.limits: Trigger assumes stochastic flow policies; latency measured on one GPU; no independent reproduction.

entries.title: Policy-Aligned Predictive Verification
entries.mechanism: Scores action prefixes in the VLA's task-conditioned representation using trajectory-survival supervision and a localization prior.
entries.evidence: Authors report improved success-query tradeoffs across pi0, pi0.5, LIBERO, RoboTwin 2, and real manipulation.
entries.limits: Abstract provides no unified numeric results; terminal supervision may ambiguously attribute intermediate failure.

entries.title: ForkCast
entries.mechanism: Candidate-conditioned latent world model compares Commit, Reobserve, and Replan at a shared future horizon using one task-progress head.
entries.evidence: Authors report pooled RoboTwin 2 success 13.3 to 30 percent under occlusion and slip, transfer to two backbones, and real-robot gains after candidate adaptation.
entries.limits: Only three fixed candidates; real adaptation requires rollouts; code not yet released.

entries.title: ACRO: Actor-Critic Rollout Orchestration
entries.mechanism: Q/V critic selects when and where to intervene; trajectory retraction returns near a visited state and the fixed VLA resumes from a fresh observation.
entries.evidence: Authors report +10.4, +7.3, and +21.7 points in SimplerEnv, RoboCasa, and real manipulation under matched physical budgets including return motion.
entries.limits: Requires deployed-policy rollouts and assumes safe useful re-entry near visited trajectories.

entries.title: Back on Track: Policy-Aligned Recovery with a Latent World Model
entries.mechanism: Policy-conditioned liveness monitor triggers short-horizon latent-world-model planning, then returns control to a fixed black-box policy.
entries.evidence: Authors report significant gains on LIBERO-Goal and Franka with pi0.5 and diffusion policies.
entries.limits: No unified abstract numbers; project page was unavailable during verification.

entries.title: When to Ask for Help
entries.mechanism: Uses value of information to schedule costly slow modules and audits detector leakage and whether feedback changes execution.
entries.evidence: Authors report leak-free detector AUC falling from 0.93 to 0.62 on 929 traces and compiled refresh periods within 2.4 percent of oracle.
entries.limits: Single-author preprint; language rewriting failed to reliably convert queries into gains.

entries.title: Value as Memory: Online Value-Guided Post-training for General Robot Policies
entries.mechanism: Caches recent value predictions as task-progress memory and combines demonstrations, interventions, and on-policy rollouts for online real-world RL.
entries.evidence: Authors report +29.4 percent absolute success from value caching and +32.8 percent from online autonomous learning over matched offline training.
entries.limits: Value errors may become compressed false memory; no independent reproduction.

entries.title: LTM: Latent Transition Based In-Context Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
entries.mechanism: Stores compact latent transitions with a frozen latent-action encoder, lightweight adapter, delayed admission, and causal KV cache.
entries.evidence: Authors report RoboMME 58.54 percent, LIBERO-Mem 80.5 percent, and real counting 11.25 to 82.5 percent.
entries.limits: Full training recommends eight H100 GPUs; cross-paper benchmark numbers are not directly comparable.

entries.title: An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory
entries.mechanism: A slow VLM reads an FSM procedural memory to select proactive tasks, a VLA executes, and a reflection VLM updates memory daily without weight changes.
entries.evidence: Authors report five-day first-fire delay falling from about five seconds to one second and recovery from a routine change after one memory update.
entries.limits: One desk routine and user-style personalization; false-assistance cost is underexplored.

entries.title: Mem4Act: Learning Effective Latent Memory for Long-Horizon Manipulation
entries.mechanism: Fixed-size control-oriented latent memory with multi-granularity temporal aggregation, QA supervision, keyframe reconstruction, and memory-first training.
entries.evidence: Authors report RoboMME 49.88 percent, RMBench 61.0 percent, and 81.5 percent on four real tasks.
entries.limits: Training-internal memory rather than a plug-in harness; protocol differs from LTM and MaP-WAM.

entries.title: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
entries.mechanism: Inherits a compact actor-critic across tasks and distills cached prior actor targets on retained episodes while the critic adapts only to the current task.
entries.evidence: Authors report 31.0-68.5 percent less robot interaction on AutoMate, 38.7-42.9 percent less on NIST, and 118/120 final prior-task successes.
entries.limits: Robot-time metric excludes demonstration collection and training wall time; simulation point estimates omit displayed uncertainty.

entries.title: WorldOracle: Benchmarking Action-Conditioned World Models against Real-World Executions
entries.mechanism: Compares action-conditioned predictions with paired real executions under identical initial observations and low-level actions across physical state, spatial alignment, local fidelity, and multi-view coherence.
entries.evidence: Official release covers three embodiments, human-operated and policy-rollout distributions, successful and failed long episodes, evaluation code, data, and leaderboard submission.
entries.limits: World-model evaluation does not itself prove recovery utility; paper and live leaderboard use different VLM evaluators.

entries.title: Cracking Mobile Manipulation
entries.mechanism: Combines demonstration-guided planning, adaptive visual memory, accessibility-aware base adjustment, and local end-effector correction.
entries.evidence: Authors report RoboCasa365 19 to 47, held-out 18 to 49, BEHAVIOR-1K 14 to 37, and real robot 5/20 to 13/20.
entries.limits: Intervention bundle needs component attribution; code not yet released.
